name: Nightly Audit Engineer
tagline: Reads your repository overnight and lands one small cleanup per area
description: Aimed at codebases that gather small messes faster than anyone gets round to clearing them. While you sleep it works through the project to build a picture of how the parts fit together, then commits to one narrow, contained improvement in each area it studied: visible by morning, small enough to review without dread.
author: lingxi
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
